clues.text: Called the Moreshite, this prophet received the word of the LORD in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah.
Elders defending Jeremiah recalled this prophet warning Judah that Zion would be plowed like a field.
When Jeremiah faced death, elders noted that King Hezekiah never killed this earlier prophet but sought the LORD's favor.
This prophet foretold that a ruler over Israel would come from Bethlehem Ephrathah, small among the clans of Judah.
This prophet of Judah said the LORD requires people to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God.
A prophet in Hezekiah's day, he saw the mountains melt beneath the LORD like wax before the fire.
This prophet of Judah declared that God will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.
